subject: Important Update: Your upcoming flight details
body: Dear Valued Customer, We are excited to inform you that your flight booking for the upcoming business trip has been successfully confirmed. Please find attached the e-ticket containing all the necessary details such as flight timings, seat allocation, and baggage allowance. Should you have any queries or require further assistance, feel free to reach out to our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board soon. Safe travels!
